notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.

description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
